blacklistabilityReview.evidence: At finalized Ethereum block 26506658 (2026-11-27T12:51:35Z), StakedToken 0xdbdc1ef57537e34680b898e1febd3d68c7389bcb has zero EIP-1967 implementation, admin, and beacon slots and verified immutable OpenZeppelin ERC4626/ERC20 transfer logic. CoreControlled inherits Pausable, and pause() sets maxDeposit/maxMint/maxWithdraw/maxRedeem to zero, but StakedToken does not inherit ERC20Pausable or gate transfer/transferFrom with whenNotPaused, nor does it include a holder blacklist, freeze mapping, or per-holder balance seizure path. YieldSharing FINANCE_MANAGER can call applyLosses() to burn vault-held iUSD pro rata across shares, not freeze individual wallets. Because canonical parent iusd-infinifi carries reviewedStatus inherited (majority custodial USDC, fund, and private-credit reserves), siusd-infinifi inherits upstream freeze exposure without a direct holder-freeze surface on the immutable Ethereum token contract. Verdict: inherited.

oracleRisk.summary: siUSD share conversion reads StakedToken.totalAssets(), which equals vault-held iUSD minus unvested epoch rewards and changes when YieldSharingV3 accrues protocol profits or slashes vault principal via applyLosses(). YieldSharingV3.unaccruedYield() depends on infiniFi Accounting valuations across off-chain private credit and funds (monthly administrator NAV for Fasanara slices and protocol accounting for New Silver and other farms), and negative unaccruedYield() immediately zeroes maxRedeem and maxWithdraw until accrue() executes. No local borrower liquidation engine runs on siUSD.
